mapper.sql: (SELECT COUNT(u.id) FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.code = 'STUDENT' WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 AND u.class_name IN (SELECT ec.class_name FROM ex_exam_class ec WHERE ec.exam_id = e.id))
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ex_exam WHERE deleted = 0) AS examCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ex_paper WHERE deleted = 0) AS paperCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qz_question WHERE deleted = 0) AS questionCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE deleted = 0) AS accountCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM an_exam_record r JOIN ex_exam e ON e.id = r.exam_id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE r.status IN (1, 2, 3)) AS attemptCount, (SELECT AVG(r.total_score) FROM an_exam_record r JOIN ex_exam e ON e.id = r.exam_id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE r.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND r.total_score IS NOT NULL) AS avgScore, (SELECT COUNT(r.total_score) FROM an_exam_record r JOIN ex_exam e ON e.id = r.exam_id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE r.status IN (1, 2, 3)) AS scoredCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM an_exam_record r JOIN ex_exam e ON e.id = r.exam_id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE r.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND r.pass_flag = 1) AS passCount
SELECT q.q_type AS qType, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM qz_question q WHERE q.deleted = 0 GROUP BY q.q_type
SELECT q.difficulty AS difficulty, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM qz_question q WHERE q.deleted = 0 GROUP BY q.difficulty

SELECT e.id AS examId, e.title AS title, DATE_FORMAT(e.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS endTime, COALESCE(s.submitCount, 0) AS submitCount, s.avgRate AS avgRate FROM ex_exam e LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.exam_id AS exam_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN r.user_id END) AS submitCount, AVG(CASE WHEN r.status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN r.total_score / NULLIF(p.total_score, 0) * 100 END) AS avgRate FROM an_exam_record r JOIN ex_exam e2 ON e2.id = r.exam_id AND e2.deleted = 0 JOIN ex_paper p ON p.id = e2.paper_id GROUP BY r.exam_id) s ON s.exam_id = e.id WHERE e.deleted = 0 ORDER BY e.end_time DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT e.id AS examId, e.paper_id AS paperId, e.title AS title, e.score_published AS scorePublished, p.title AS paperTitle, p.total_score AS totalScore, p.pass_score AS passScore, CASE WHEN e.audience_type = 3 THEN COALESCE(s.joinCount, 0) WHEN e.audience_type = 2 THEN ELSE (SELECT COUNT(u.id) FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.code = 'STUDENT' WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1) END AS expectedCount, COALESCE(s.joinCount, 0) AS joinCount, COALESCE(s.submitCount, 0) AS submitCount, COALESCE(s.scoredCount, 0) AS scoredCount, COALESCE(s.passCount, 0) AS passCount, s.avgScore AS avgScore, s.maxScore AS maxScore, s.minScore AS minScore FROM ex_exam e LEFT JOIN ex_paper p ON p.id = e.paper_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.exam_id AS exam_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_id) AS joinCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN r.user_id END) AS submitCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN r.total_score END) AS scoredCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND r.pass_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passCount, AVG(CASE WHEN r.status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN r.total_score END) AS avgScore, MAX(CASE WHEN r.status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN r.total_score END) AS maxScore, MIN(CASE WHEN r.status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN r.total_score END) AS minScore FROM an_exam_record r WHERE r.exam_id = #{examId} GROUP BY r.exam_id) s ON s.exam_id = e.id WHERE e.id = #{examId} AND e.deleted = 0

SELECT pq.id AS paperQuestionId, pq.question_id AS questionId, pq.q_type AS qType, pq.content AS content, pq.score AS fullScore, pq.difficulty AS difficulty, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN ai.id END) AS answerCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND ai.correct_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correctCount FROM ex_paper_question pq LEFT JOIN an_answer_item ai ON ai.paper_question_id = pq.id LEFT JOIN an_exam_record r ON r.id = ai.record_id AND r.exam_id = #{examId} WHERE pq.paper_id = (SELECT e.paper_id FROM ex_exam e WHERE e.id = #{examId} AND e.deleted = 0) GROUP BY pq.id, pq.question_id, pq.q_type, pq.content, pq.score, pq.difficulty, pq.sort_no ORDER BY pq.sort_no, pq.id

SELECT r.id AS recordId, r.total_score / NULLIF(p.total_score, 0) * 100 AS rate FROM an_exam_record r JOIN ex_exam e ON e.id = r.exam_id AND e.deleted = 0 JOIN ex_paper p ON p.id = e.paper_id WHERE r.exam_id = #{examId} AND r.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND r.total_score IS NOT NULL AND p.total_score > 0 ORDER BY r.total_score / NULLIF(p.total_score, 0) DESC, r.id

SELECT ai.paper_question_id AS paperQuestionId, AS grp, AVG(CASE WHEN ai.correct_flag = 1 THEN 1.0 WHEN ai.correct_flag = 2 THEN 0.5 ELSE 0 END) AS credit FROM an_answer_item ai WHERE ai.record_id IN #{rid} OR ai.record_id IN #{rid} GROUP BY ai.paper_question_id,

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(u.class_name, ''), '未分班') AS className, COUNT(*) AS cnt, AVG(r.total_score) AS avgScore, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.pass_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passCount FROM an_exam_record r JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE r.exam_id = #{examId} AND r.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND r.total_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(u.class_name, ''), '未分班') ORDER BY AVG(r.total_score) DESC, className

SELECT q.id AS questionId, q.content AS content, q.q_type AS qType, q.difficulty AS difficulty, q.analysis AS analysis, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ex_paper_question pq JOIN ex_paper p ON p.id = pq.paper_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE pq.question_id = q.id) AS paperCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM an_answer_item ai JOIN an_exam_record r ON r.id = ai.record_id AND r.status IN (1, 2, 3) WHERE ai.question_id = q.id) AS answerCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM an_answer_item ai JOIN an_exam_record r ON r.id = ai.record_id AND r.status IN (1, 2, 3) WHERE ai.question_id = q.id AND ai.correct_flag = 1) AS correctCount FROM qz_question q WHERE q.id = #{questionId} AND q.deleted = 0

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.exam_id) FROM an_exam_record r JOIN ex_exam e ON e.id = r.exam_id AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.score_published = 1 WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status IN (1, 2, 3)) AS examCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM an_exam_record r JOIN ex_exam e ON e.id = r.exam_id AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.score_published = 1 WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status IN (1, 2, 3)) AS submitCount, (SELECT COUNT(r.total_score) FROM an_exam_record r JOIN ex_exam e ON e.id = r.exam_id AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.score_published = 1 WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status IN (1, 2, 3)) AS scoredCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM an_exam_record r JOIN ex_exam e ON e.id = r.exam_id AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.score_published = 1 WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND r.pass_flag = 1) AS passCount, (SELECT AVG(r.total_score / NULLIF(p.total_score, 0) * 100) FROM an_exam_record r JOIN ex_exam e ON e.id = r.exam_id AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.score_published = 1 JOIN ex_paper p ON p.id = e.paper_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND r.total_score IS NOT NULL) AS avgRate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM an_answer_item ai JOIN an_exam_record r ON r.id = ai.record_id AND r.status IN (1, 2, 3) JOIN ex_exam e ON e.id = r.exam_id AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.score_published = 1 WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND ai.correct_flag = 0) AS wrongCount

SELECT r.id AS recordId, r.exam_id AS examId, e.title AS examTitle, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(r.submit_time, r.start_time), '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, r.total_score AS score, p.total_score AS totalScore, CASE WHEN r.total_score IS NOT NULL THEN r.total_score / NULLIF(p.total_score, 0) * 100 END AS rate, r.pass_flag AS passFlag FROM an_exam_record r JOIN ex_exam e ON e.id = r.exam_id AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.score_published = 1 LEFT JOIN ex_paper p ON p.id = e.paper_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status IN (1, 2, 3) ORDER BY COALESCE(r.submit_time, r.start_time), r.id

WITH RECURSIVE root_cat AS (SELECT c.id AS category_id, c.name AS root_name FROM qz_category c WHERE c.parent_id = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT child.id, rc.root_name FROM qz_category child JOIN root_cat rc ON child.parent_id = rc.category_id WHERE child.deleted = 0) SELECT rc.root_name AS name, COUNT(*) AS answerCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ai.correct_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correctCount FROM an_answer_item ai JOIN an_exam_record r ON r.id = ai.record_id AND r.status IN (1, 2, 3) JOIN ex_exam e ON e.id = r.exam_id AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.score_published = 1 JOIN qz_question q ON q.id = ai.question_id JOIN root_cat rc ON rc.category_id = q.category_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND ai.correct_flag IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rc.root_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, rc.root_name

SELECT q.q_type AS qType, COUNT(*) AS answerCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ai.correct_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correctCount FROM an_answer_item ai JOIN an_exam_record r ON r.id = ai.record_id AND r.status IN (1, 2, 3) JOIN ex_exam e ON e.id = r.exam_id AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.score_published = 1 JOIN qz_question q ON q.id = ai.question_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND ai.correct_flag IS NOT NULL GROUP BY q.q_type ORDER BY q.q_type

SELECT q.difficulty AS difficulty, COUNT(*) AS answerCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ai.correct_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correctCount FROM an_answer_item ai JOIN an_exam_record r ON r.id = ai.record_id AND r.status IN (1, 2, 3) JOIN ex_exam e ON e.id = r.exam_id AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.score_published = 1 JOIN qz_question q ON q.id = ai.question_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND ai.correct_flag IS NOT NULL GROUP BY q.difficulty ORDER BY q.difficulty
